subject: URGENT: Your Account Has Been Compromised
body:
Dear Customer,

We have detected unusual activity on your account. Your account has been temporarily limited.

Please verify your identity immediately by clicking the link below:
http://paypa1-verify.com/account/secure

If you do not verify within 24 hours, your account will be permanently suspended.

Thank you,
PayPal Security Team
